about: The headline reasons Odd one out may give (design section 5.3). members/odd: three share it and the odd one lacks it; oddOnly/others: only the odd one has it. A rule with no oddOnly phrase is never used that way round. tier 1 = anyone would think of it, tier 2 = needs some Bible knowledge; easy: true = a tier-2 rule well enough known for Easy rounds. keyRef = the BSB verse (or two) quoted on the reveal.
